inquiry.share_your_dates_and_group_size_our_team: Share your dates and group size. Our team will confirm availability, arrangements, and final pricing.
inquiry.no_payment_is_taken_today_your_stay_is_c: No payment is taken today. Your stay is confirmed only after our team contacts you.

hero.stay_stream_sing_and_grill_with_your_fav: Stay, stream, sing, and grill with your favorite people. From a small getaway to a whole-building celebration, there’s room for your crew.

story.a_little_sea_air_a_lot_of_time_together: A little sea air. A lot of time together.
story.odidepse_puts_you_a_25_second_walk_from_: Odidepse puts you a 25-second walk from the beach, with air-conditioned rooms and shared spaces for cooking, singing, and catching up.
story.bring_the_family_gather_the_barkada_or_p: Bring the family, gather the barkada, or plan something bigger. Make the trip your own.

amenities.pack_for_the_beach_enjoy_free_wi_fi_ente: Pack for the beach. Enjoy free Wi-Fi, entertainment, and the shared essentials that make group trips easier.

stays.from_5_guest_rooms_to_an_exclusive_build: From 5-guest rooms to an exclusive building for 88–100 guests. Tell us your dates and we’ll confirm the right arrangement.
stays.room_counts_describe_accommodation_optio: Room counts describe accommodation options, not live availability. Please inquire for your dates, group arrangement, and rates.

group_highlight.plan_a_reunion_company_outing_or_celebra: Plan a reunion, company outing, or celebration with flexible room arrangements. Ask about a private pool for large groups or exclusive use of the entire building for 88–100 guests.

experiences.take_your_beach_day_up_a_notch_ask_us_ab: Take your beach day up a notch. Ask us about rental availability when planning your stay.

location.find_us_along_purok_8_coastal_road_in_br: Find us along Purok 8 Coastal Road in Brgy. Sto. Niño, where San Felipe meets the West Philippine Sea.

closing.because_your_beach_trip_should_be_all_th: Because your beach trip should be all three. From beach days and jet ski rides to karaoke nights and late-night grilling, make room for memories with your favorite people.

reviews.name: A family by the sea
reviews.quote: Our favorite part was being together. Plenty of photos, long conversations, and a sunset we wished would last a little longer.
